Tobias Mwangi-Hartley
[EMAIL] | [PHONE] | [LINKEDIN]
Data Scientist | Applied Machine Learning

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Data Scientist with experience applying machine learning and statistical modelling to demand forecasting, churn propensity and experimentation. Built Python workflows for scheduled forecasting and weekly batch scoring, and a Streamlit experiment-planning tool used by product and growth teams. Seeking to deepen production ML engineering practice while contributing applied modelling, data analysis and testing skills.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
Programming and libraries: Python, SQL, R, pandas, scikit-learn, LightGBM, XGBoost, statsmodels, Streamlit
Machine learning and statistics: Demand forecasting, churn propensity modelling, feature engineering, model evaluation, SHAP, Bayesian hierarchical models, experimental design, sequential A/B testing
Data and platforms: BigQuery, dbt, Vertex AI Workbench, Looker, R Markdown, Docker, pytest
Additional learning: PyTorch and torchvision (course project)

EXPERIENCE
Data Scientist | Thistlebox | 2022–Present
• Developed a weekly demand forecast for orders by recipe and region, six weeks ahead, using LightGBM and calendar, price and menu-position features.
• Improved forecast WAPE from 23% to 14%; estimated food waste reduction of 9%. The forecast runs as a scheduled Vertex AI Workbench notebook, writes to BigQuery, and is used by operations in Looker.
• Built an XGBoost churn propensity model scored weekly in BigQuery; retention offers are sent to top-decile customers. In a 10% holdout validation, churn was down 2.1 percentage points in the treated group.
• Built a Streamlit app for planning and analysing sequential A/B tests, used by approximately 25 people in product and growth. Wrote its Dockerfile; the data platform team hosts it on Cloud Run and handles deployment.
• Since 2025, written pytest unit tests for forecasting feature code, reaching approximately 60% coverage.

Junior Data Analyst | Firth Energy Retail | 2020–2022
• Segmented customers and analysed tariffs using R and SQL.
• Automated monthly regulator reports with R Markdown, saving the team approximately two days each month.

EDUCATION
MSc in Statistics
Dissertation: Bayesian hierarchical models

ADDITIONAL PROJECT
Image classification course project | 2025
Fine-tuned a small CNN in PyTorch on a public food images dataset, achieving approximately 80% accuracy. Learning project completed as part of an online deep learning course.
docs.cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the Machine Learning Engineer – Customer Support AI role at Quillstone Payments. In my current data science work, I have built and evaluated machine learning workflows that inform operational decisions, including demand forecasting and weekly churn scoring. I am interested in bringing that applied experience to a team developing AI systems that help merchants get support quickly and without friction.

At Thistlebox, I developed a six-week demand forecast using LightGBM, with scheduled notebook outputs written to BigQuery and used by operations in Looker. Forecast WAPE improved from 23% to 14%, with an estimated 9% reduction in food waste. I also built a weekly XGBoost churn-scoring workflow in BigQuery; in a 10% holdout validation, churn was down 2.1 percentage points in the treated group. These projects have given me practical experience with feature engineering, model evaluation and data workflows used in ongoing business processes.

I have also built a Python Streamlit app for planning and analysing sequential A/B tests, now used by approximately 25 colleagues in product and growth. I wrote the app and its Dockerfile, while the data platform team handles its Cloud Run deployment. Since 2025, I have been writing pytest unit tests for forecasting feature code, reaching approximately 60% coverage. Alongside an MSc in Statistics and experience with Python, SQL and BigQuery, this has strengthened my interest in developing further as an ML engineer and contributing to the engineering practices that take ML systems into production.

Quillstone’s focus on customer-support automation for merchants makes this role a compelling next step for me. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my background in applied modelling, experimentation and data workflows could contribute to the AI team within Customer Operations.

Kind regards,
Tobias Mwangi-Hartley
